_format: Each line is one Chatterbox take. Tokens split on spaces. [shown=spoken] gives a spoken form. Suffix *y = yellow keyword, *r = red keyword, *g = green (safe). A trailing / ends a caption phrase. fx: radio = PA speaker, janitor / mimic / friend = pitch-shifted character voices (from the narrator's take). pause = silence after the line (s).
title: AFTER HOURS Day 2

lines.text: Every speaker*y in your school/ is also a microphone.*r/
Your best friend*y knocked for eleven minutes.*y/ You didn't make a sound./
Then the knocking stopped./ And from the hallway,/ in her voice:/
Okay./ I'll find another way in.*r/
So you hide./ Under the front desk.*y/
Solid wood.*g/ One way in.*g/ A wall at your back.*g/
The perfect spot./ Except for one detail.*r/
Right above you,/ on the wall./ A speaker.*y/ The same one that's in every room./
School intercoms are two-way.*y/ The front office can talk to any room.*y/ And listen to it.*r/
That's how it knew/ there was still a student here.*r/
Rule number four.*r/ If the speaker's light is red,/ it's listening.*r/
Down the hall,/ a speaker clicks on.*y/ Room [104=one-oh-four].*y/ A hiss./ Then off./
[106=One-oh-six].*y/ [108=One-oh-eight].*y/ It's checking every room./
The library/ is [110=one-ten].*r/
Click.*r/ The light above you/ turns red.*r/
You stop breathing./
Next door,/ in [108=one-oh-eight],/ someone coughs.*r/
Your light goes dark.*g/ Footsteps run past the library door,/ toward [108=one-oh-eight].*r/
Then [108=one-oh-eight]/ goes quiet.*r/
For a minute,/ nothing./ Then every speaker in the school*y/ clicks on at once./
And a voice you know says:/
Maya?*y/ It's me.*y/ I'm in the library./ Come find me./
It's your voice.*r/ It's been listening to your classroom/ all day./
Your phone lights up.*y/ Maya.*y/ Is that you?/ I'm in the band room./ Coming now.*r/
You text back,/ don't.*r/ Delivered./ Not read./ She's already walking./
The phone on the desk*y/ has a code taped to it./ Page all.*y/ Star [21=twenty-one].*y/
Dial it,/ and your real voice/ is on every speaker in the school./
And it hears*r exactly where you are./
Warn Maya,*g/ or stay hidden?*r/ Comment one or two./
